target_platform: Expo React Native Mobile App (iOS / Android primary, Mobile Web preview)

layouts_and_grids.structure: Mobile-first stack navigation with dedicated Admin Drawer/Tab navigation bar and Header with Quick Work Queue shortcuts.
layouts_and_grids.top_bar: Sticky Header with Back / Menu trigger, Admin Title, Module Switcher, Actionable Alerts Counter, and Profile Quick Pill.
layouts_and_grids.dense_mobile_grid: Single-column cards for mobile screens (<600px), 2-column key-metric grid for stats, bottom sheets for item details and quick-edit forms.
layouts_and_grids.filter_bar: Horizontal scrollable chip bar for status filtering (e.g. All, Pending, Approved, Flagged, Archived).

accessibility.contrast_standard: WCAG AA / APCA compliant on #FAFBF9 and #0F291E backgrounds
accessibility.min_touch_target: 44x44 dp for all pressable buttons and table row actions
accessibility.test_id_attribute: data-testid required on all interactive elements, input fields, tabs, switches, and action triggers

default_admin_account.initial_credentials_protocol: Generated secure seed hash in backend/seed.py with force-change password flag on first login.

admin_credentials_and_security.authentication_storage: Secure JWT Token stored in AsyncStorage / SecureStore under 'mqulima_admin_token'.
admin_credentials_and_security.route_guard: Higher-Order Component / Guard in app/admin/_layout.tsx checking admin role before rendering admin routes.

module_1_dashboard.name: Operations Control Overview
actionable_work_queue: Reported Forum posts and comments needing moderation

module_2_products.name: Products & Variant Catalog Manager
features: Product List with search by name/category and status filter (Published/Archived)
Create / Edit Product Form (Name, Category, Base Price, Image URL, Description, Stock, Featured toggle)
Variant Manager (Label, Price adjustment, SKU, In-stock toggle)
Publish / Archive toggle without deleting historical orders

module_3_orders.name: Order Management & Fulfillment
features: Orders list with status filters (All, Processing, Dispatched, Delivered, Cancelled)
Order detail view with items, customer contact, delivery location, M-Pesa payment status
Status update action (Processing -> Dispatched -> Delivered)
Filter by County / Subcounty for regional logistics dispatching

module_4_forum.name: Forum Moderation
features: Discussion threads feed with search and tag filters (Questions, Crop Health, Markets, etc.)
Hide / Restore thread toggle
Inline reply list with individual comment hide / delete controls
Author user profile link and user warnings

module_5_users.name: User Management & Moderation
features: Searchable users table (Name, Email, Phone, County, Role, Status)
Suspend / Unsuspend user account action
Role assignment (Farmer, Agronomist, Vendor, Admin)
User activity quick summary (Orders placed, threads created, service requests)

module_6_news.name: News & Agronomy Articles Publishing
features: Article list grouped by category (Crop Guide, Market News, Advisory)
Create & Edit Article form (Title, Category, Excerpt, Content markdown, Banner image, Read time)
Publish date & featured article toggle

module_7_services.name: Service Catalogue & Request Dispatch
features: Service Catalogue manager (Finance, Soil, Crop, Animal Health, Irrigation, Value Addition)
Service Requests queue (Customer name, Farm county, Service type, Urgency, Status)
Expert Assignment drawer (Assign vetted agronomist/vet/contractor to customer request)
Status tracker (Pending -> Assigned -> In Progress -> Completed)

module_8_academy.name: Academy Courses & Waitlist Manager
features: Course editor (Title, Level, Duration, Outcomes, Image)
Module & Lesson builder with preview content editor
Academy Launch Waitlist table with export/contact actions

module_9_inbox.name: Contact Inbox & Enquiries
features: General enquiries feed from public contact page
Status filter (Unread, In Progress, Resolved)
Quick reply & WhatsApp/Phone direct trigger

module_10_audit_and_settings.name: Audit Log & Admin Password Settings
features: Activity Audit Log showing timestamps, admin email, action taken (e.g. 'Archived Product #102', 'Suspended User #54')
Admin Password change form with security validation
System health indicator

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Keep existing public UI app files untouched in app/(tabs)/, app/product/, app/services/, etc.
2. Implement protected admin section inside app/admin/_layout.tsx and sub-routes in app/admin/* using Expo Router.
3. Ensure admin authentication routes in backend/routes/auth.py handle admin role verification and admin seed initialization in backend/seed.py.
4. Use design tokens from /app/frontend/src/theme.ts (#FAFBF9 background, #0F291E text, #16A34A brand primary) for consistent brand identity.
5. Use dense mobile list components with bottom-sheet detail editors for optimal mobile web preview and touch experience.
6. Include data-testid attributes on all input components, buttons, tabs, filter chips, and action icons for automated testing.
7. Rely on true database metrics from MongoDB collections (products, orders, threads, users, articles, service_requests) - no fake static charts.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Do not alter public pages or break public navigation.
Maintain strict mobile web responsiveness with 44x44 minimum touch targets.
Always test interactive states and add data-testid attributes for E2E testing.
Ensure all async state changes provide toast notifications via src/components/Floating.tsx.
